urls.rationale: Act 472 of 1978 - LOBBYISTS, LOBBYING AGENTS, AND LOBBYING ACTIVITIES (MCL 4.411 - 4.431): Michigan's Lobby Registration Act — single-act regime containing registration, expenditure reporting, definitions, and penalties.

notes: Act 214 of 1947 (LEGISLATIVE AGENTS, 4.401-4.410) appears in Chapter 4 but is marked 'Repealed-' on Justia — Act 472 of 1978 explicitly repealed it (per § 4.431). Snapshot exposes act-level URLs only (Justia structures MCL as chapter > act > section); pass 3 will fetch the act directory to enumerate sections.
